items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Now we've got George Rhodes by this time.

ctx.x: They had good promotion at that time.

Oh, yeah. Sure. And it had a good sound. And they said, "Now, we're going to make one, make an album with you. We're going to call it Muted Jazz." Now, we play everything, all the things, the little arrangements, like, "Too Close for Comfort." A nice arrangement we had on there. Now we've got George Rhodes by this time. We've got George Rhodes. The other piano player, he thinks he's doing me a favor. I'm paying him the scale, but he says that, "I ain't going to help nobody build no band. That's all I did all my…

"On the Street Where You Live." I said, "Oh, Dave, we don't know that thing." He said, "Well, I heard you do it in the club." I said, "We only do that when somebody asks for it. We just play the melody." He said, "Well, that's all I want you to do, play the melody. Play it through once and come back and play it an octave higher the second time, start from the last half." And he says, "Give it a shuffle beat." And he told the drummer just what kind of shuffle he wanted, because I had never played with a shuffle…
